aboutBio: I am in my fifth year of Software Engineering at the National Advanced School of Engineering of Douala (ENSPD), Cameroon.
My studies focus on software design and development. I am particularly interested in web applications, user experience, and data management.

I work with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, Figma, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. I aspire to become a DevOps engineer because I enjoy automating repetitive tasks and want to help teams deploy reliable applications faster.
contactValues: Open to internships and collaborations, on-site or remote. I gained my first professional experience during a three-and-a-half-month internship.

campuscart.title: CampusCart: Campus Services Marketplace
campuscart.cardDescription: Connecting students who offer and need everyday services — printing, tech help, tutoring — in one trusted, campus-only app.
campuscart.description: A peer-to-peer marketplace where students post, find and request everyday services on campus — turning idle time and skills into quick, trusted exchanges.
campuscart.alt: CampusCart campus services marketplace home screen mockup

highlights.title: Service-first, not product-first
highlights.description: Every flow is built around requesting and fulfilling a service — not browsing a catalog — so matching is fast and trust (ratings, campus verification) stays central.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: Everyday needs that campuses leave uncovered.
problem.description: Printing, tech help or tutoring: students usually rely on scattered WhatsApp groups, with no trust, no pricing and no way to find the right person quickly.

objective.label: OBJECTIVE
objective.title: One trusted place to offer and request services.
objective.description: Connect students who offer a service with students who need it, inside one campus-only app.

items.title: Service offers
items.description: Post a service in under a minute.

items.title: Categories
items.description: Printing, tech help, tutoring and more.

items.title: Pricing
items.description: Clear price shown on every offer.

items.title: Requests
items.description: Send a request and track its status.

items.title: Messaging
items.description: Chat directly to agree on details.

items.title: Ratings
items.description: Rate each service to build trust.

nextSteps.label: NEXT STEPS
nextSteps.title: Move from concept to validation.
nextSteps.description: Next, turn the mockup into a working mobile app and validate the main flow (browse, request, chat, rate) with real students.

campuscart.overviewSubtitle: Useful services, easier to find on campus.
campuscart.overviewDescription: CampusCart is a student services marketplace concept designed in Figma. It addresses scattered informal listings by bringing services, requests and pricing into one campus-only experience. It remains a mockup, with no implemented application or user testing at this stage.
contributions: Defined the brief and the primary user flow.

highlights.title: OHADA chart of accounts

highlights.title: Accounting entries
highlights.description: Record debit and credit transactions in accounting journals.

highlights.title: Financial reporting
highlights.description: Prepare the general ledger, trial balance and financial statements.

highlights.title: Multi-company management
highlights.description: Support accounting firms managing several client companies with appropriate data isolation.

formuloo-compta.overviewDescription: Formuloo Compta is an accounting application concept designed to simplify financial management for SMEs and accounting firms. It focuses on OHADA accounting principles, structured financial records and centralized management of multiple client companies.
formuloo-compta.technicalSubtitle: Built around maintainability and data integrity.
formuloo-compta.technicalDescription: The project explores modular application architecture, role-based access control and multi-tenant data management to support reliable accounting workflows.
contributions: Ongoing software development for the accounting application.

project-management-app.title: Project Management App
project-management-app.description: A full-stack web app that brings project planning, task tracking, budgets and expenses into one place.
project-management-app.alt: Project management dashboard shown on desktop and mobile, with projects, tasks, budgets and expenses.

highlights.title: Project organization
highlights.description: Keep project details and active work together so teams can see what is in progress.

highlights.title: Task management
highlights.description: Create tasks, connect them to projects and follow their status.

highlights.title: Progress tracking
highlights.description: Review project and task statuses at a glance to spot work that needs attention.

highlights.title: Budgets and expenses
highlights.description: Review budget allocations alongside recorded spending to keep project costs visible.

project-management-app.overviewSubtitle: Give teams a clear view of work, progress and spending.
project-management-app.overviewDescription: Project work and costs can be hard to follow when they are scattered across tools. Project Management App brings project organization, task tracking, budgets and expenses into one workspace, helping teams coordinate delivery and keep spending visible.

technologies.name: Node.js
technologies.description: Runs the JavaScript application code on the server.

technologies.name: Express
technologies.description: Provides the server-side web framework for handling HTTP requests.

principles: I care about code that works in production, not only on my machine, so I test it, containerize it and deploy it.
Scripts, Docker and CI/CD remove repetitive steps and reduce human mistakes.
Clear READMEs, diagrams and commit messages help others, and future me, pick a project up fast.
I share what I build and what I get wrong, then turn feedback into the next iteration.
